title: Elimination of an etale middle factor in a tensor comparison
statement: Fix the finite coefficient setting of [def-pur-conventions] and the canonical exceptional composition, normalized etale comparison, tensor and derived pullback comparisons of [def-pur-finite-exceptional-composition], [lem-pur-finite-etale-dualizing-normalization], [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition] and [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. All schemes are finite-type schemes over $k$ and all morphisms below are separated finite-type $k$-morphisms [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Let $q:A\to T$, $p:T\to B$ and $q_Q:R\to Q$ be smooth of pure relative dimensions $d_q,d_p,d_q$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $G:Q\to T$ and $J:R\to A$ be etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], and let $w:Jq=q_QG$. Write $\omega_f=Rf^!\Lambda$, $E_{e,f}:\omega_{ef}\simeq Le^*\omega_f$, and $\sigma_{f,g}$ for the specified maps. Choose a morphism $x:\omega_{q_Q}\to LJ^*\omega_q$ satisfying $\operatorname{targetUnit}_{q_Q,G}^{-1}\,\sigma_{q_Q,G}\,\operatorname{congr}(w^{-1})\,E_{J,q}=x$, where products here list maps in application order. Let $S:Lq_Q^*LG^*\omega_p\to LJ^*Lq^*\omega_p$ be inverse canonical $(q_Q,G)$ pullback composition followed by the canonical $(J,q)$ composition using $w^{-1}$. Then $\sigma_{q_Q,Gp}$ followed by the canonical exceptional transport from $q_Q(Gp)$ to $J(qp)$ and $E_{J,qp}$ equals the tensor of $x$ and $Lq_Q^*E_{G,p}$ followed by $S$, followed by the inverse canonical $J$ pullback-tensor comparison and $LJ^*\sigma_{q,p}$. Thus both sides map $\omega_{q_Q}\otimes Lq_Q^*\omega_{Gp}$ to $LJ^*\omega_{qp}$. No Cartesian hypothesis is needed.

proof.text:
Apply the smooth-triple cocycle to $(q_Q,G,p)$ and remove $\omega_G$ using $\eta_G$. The normalized identity $E_{G,p}\sigma_{G,p}=\eta_G\otimes1$ then gives
$$\sigma_{q_Q,b}=\sigma_{Gq_Q,p}(\sigma_{q_Q,G}\otimes1)(1\otimes Lq_Q^*E_{G,p}).$$
Indeed the cocycle first equates $\sigma_{Gq_Q,p}(\sigma_{q_Q,G}\otimes1)$ with $\sigma_{q_Q,b}(1\otimes Lq_Q^*\sigma_{G,p})$; compose on the right with the inverse of this last input map. All factors then have the reassociated source $\omega_{q_Q}\otimes Lq_Q^*\omega_b$.

Apply the etale-source sigma identity to (J,q,p). Replace J followed by q by qQ followed by G using w. Substitute the previous step and the assumed equation hfirst with its arbitrary x, retaining the target unit identification. Tensor functoriality combines the two first-input maps into x and the two second-input maps into qQ-pullback of E_G,p followed by the canonical square pullback comparison. Naturality of the tensor-pullback constraint gives precisely the displayed inverse J tensor comparison followed by J-pullback of sigma_q,p.

    (q : A ⟶ T) [q.IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated q] [LocallyOfFiniteType q] [QuasiCompact q]
    (p : T ⟶ B) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated p] [LocallyOfFiniteType p] [QuasiCompact p]
    (G : Q ⟶ T) [G.IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated G] [LocallyOfFiniteType G] [QuasiCompact G]
    [Etale G]
    (qQ : R ⟶ Q) [qQ.IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated qQ] [LocallyOfFiniteType qQ] [QuasiCompact qQ]
    (J : R ⟶ A) [J.IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated J] [LocallyOfFiniteType J] [QuasiCompact J]
    [Etale J]
    (dq dp : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension dq q] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension dp p]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension dq qQ]
    (w : J ≫ q = qQ ≫ G)
    (x : omega P qQ ⟶ (pull P J).obj (omega P q))
    (hfirst : (targetUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) qQ G (cf := compactification P qQ)
        (ce := compactification P G) (rho P G)).inv ≫
      sigma (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) qQ G (cf := compactification P qQ)
        (cg := compactification P G) (cfg := compactification P (qQ ≫ G)) (comp P qQ G) ≫
      (FiniteEtaleNormalization.congr P (qQ ≫ G) (J ≫ q) w.symm).hom.app
        (coefficientUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) T) ≫ (sourceEtale P J q).hom = x) :
    sigma (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) (qQ) (G ≫ p)
        (cf := compactification P (qQ)) (cg := compactification P (G ≫ p))
        (cfg := compactification P ((qQ) ≫ (G ≫ p))) (comp P (qQ) (G ≫ p)) ≫
      (FiniteEtaleNormalization.congr P ((qQ) ≫ (G ≫ p)) ((J) ≫ (q ≫ p))
        ((Category.assoc qQ G p).symm.trans
          ((congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ p) w.symm).trans (Category.assoc J q p)))).hom.app
        (coefficientUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) B) ≫
      (sourceEtale P (J) (q ≫ p)).hom =
    ((Etale.derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) _).map (x)).app
        ((pull P (qQ)).obj (omega P (G ≫ p))) ≫
      ((Etale.derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) _).obj
        ((pull P (J)).obj (omega P q))).map ((pull P qQ).map (sourceEtale P G p).hom ≫
        (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) qQ G).inv.app
          (omega P p) ≫
        (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) J q
          (qQ ≫ G) w.symm).hom.app
          (omega P p)) ≫
      (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) (J) (omega P q)
        ((pull P q).obj (omega P p))).inv ≫
      (pull P (J)).map (sigma (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) q p
        (cf := compactification P q) (cg := compactification P p)
        (cfg := compactification P (q ≫ p)) (comp P q p))
